name: Intel Arc B570
notes: Budget Intel Battlemage. 10GB GDDR6. Ollama supports Intel XPU via SYCL — best on Linux.

name: NVIDIA RTX 4060
notes: Entry-level Ada Lovelace. 8GB fits small models up to 7B Q6. Good beginner card.

name: Intel Arc B580
notes: Mid-range Intel Battlemage. 12GB GDDR6 at RTX 4060 price. SYCL/XPU backend in Ollama.

name: NVIDIA RTX 5060
notes: Entry Blackwell. 8GB GDDR7 — same VRAM as RTX 4060 but faster memory bandwidth.

name: AMD RX 9060 XT 8GB
notes: AMD RDNA 4 entry-level. 8GB GDDR6. ROCm support on Linux; limited on Windows.

name: NVIDIA RTX 5060 Ti 8GB
notes: Blackwell mid-range in 8GB config. Faster than RTX 4060 but same VRAM ceiling.

name: NVIDIA RTX 4060 Ti 16GB
notes: Best legacy value for 16GB Ada. Runs 14B models in Q6/Q8 comfortably.

name: NVIDIA RTX 5060 Ti 16GB
notes: Blackwell 16GB with GDDR7. Better efficiency than RTX 4060 Ti at the same VRAM.

name: AMD RX 9070
notes: RDNA 4 mid-range. 16GB GDDR6 with strong ROCm 6 support. Excellent Ollama value on Linux.

name: NVIDIA RTX 4070 Super
notes: Faster Ada with the same 12GB as the base 4070. Good for 7B Q8 and 13B Q4.

name: NVIDIA RTX 4070
notes: Solid Ada mid-range. 12GB fits 13B Q4 and 7B Q8. Reliable all-rounder.

name: AMD RX 9060 XT 16GB
notes: 16GB RDNA 4 at entry price. Underrated for LLM inference — ROCm on Linux recommended.

name: AMD RX 9070 XT
notes: RDNA 4 upper mid-range. Competes with RTX 5070 at lower price. Best AMD value in 2025.

name: NVIDIA RTX 3090 (used)
notes: Used market king for 24GB VRAM. Older Ampere but fully CUDA-compatible with Ollama.

name: NVIDIA RTX 5070
notes: Blackwell mid-range. Same 12GB as RTX 4070 but with much faster GDDR7 memory bandwidth.

name: NVIDIA RTX 4070 Ti Super
notes: Excellent Ada performance + 16GB. Great for 14–27B models at Q6/Q8.

name: NVIDIA RTX 5070 Ti
notes: Upper Blackwell. 16GB GDDR7 with ~30% more bandwidth than RTX 4070 Ti Super.

name: AMD RX 7900 XTX
notes: 24GB RDNA 3 at a fraction of RTX 4090 price. Strong ROCm support for Ollama on Linux.

name: NVIDIA RTX 4080 Super
notes: High-end Ada with 256-bit bus. Smooth 14–27B inference in Q8.

name: NVIDIA RTX 4000 Ada
notes: Workstation card with 20GB ECC VRAM. Low power, rack-friendly. Ada arch — full CUDA support.

name: NVIDIA RTX 5080
notes: High-end Blackwell. 16GB GDDR7 — roughly 2× the memory bandwidth of RTX 4080 Super.

name: NVIDIA RTX 4500 Ada
notes: Workstation 24GB ECC card. Low power, quiet, fits in professional systems. Full CUDA.

name: NVIDIA RTX 4090
notes: Fastest Ada Lovelace consumer GPU. 24GB fits Mistral 7B at FP16 or Phi-4 14B at Q8.

name: NVIDIA RTX 5090
notes: Flagship Blackwell. First consumer GPU with 32GB VRAM. Runs 70B models in Q4 with room.

name: 2× NVIDIA RTX 3090 (used)
notes: Multi-GPU via NVLink or tensor parallelism (llama.cpp). 48GB fits 70B in Q4 and Q8.

name: AMD Radeon Pro W7800
notes: Workstation 32GB ECC RDNA 3. Good ROCm support. Strong value for 30B+ models vs NVIDIA workstation cards.

name: NVIDIA RTX 5000 Ada
notes: Workstation 32GB ECC Ada. Low TDP, ECC memory, certified drivers. Great for 70B Q4.

name: Apple Mac M4 Max (128GB)
notes: M4 Max with 128GB unified memory. ~40% faster than M3 Max. Fits 70B Q4/Q8 comfortably. macOS only.

name: AMD Radeon Pro W7900
notes: Workstation 48GB ECC RDNA 3. Strong ROCm support, runs 70B at Q8 or larger at Q4.

name: NVIDIA RTX A6000
notes: Previous-gen Ampere workstation. 48GB ECC VRAM — widely available used. Full NVLink support.

name: Apple Mac M3 Ultra (192GB)
notes: 192GB unified memory. Silent, power-efficient, runs 70B at FP16 or larger at Q4. macOS only.

name: NVIDIA RTX 6000 Ada
notes: Flagship workstation Ada. 48GB ECC VRAM, NVLink support. Runs 70B at Q8 comfortably.

name: NVIDIA L40S
notes: AI inference workstation/server. 48GB GDDR6 with Ada arch. Optimized for multi-model serving.

name: NVIDIA A100 40GB (used)
notes: Data center Ampere GPU. 40GB HBM2e. Typically accessed via cloud/server. HBM gives very high bandwidth.

name: NVIDIA A100 80GB (server)
notes: Data center standard. 80GB HBM2e — runs 70B at FP16 with room. Usually cloud/cluster only.

name: NVIDIA H100 80GB (server)
notes: State-of-the-art data center GPU. 80GB HBM3, fastest available. Cloud/cluster only. Not for desktop.

name: AMD Instinct MI300X (server)
notes: 192GB HBM3 unified memory. Runs 405B models. Server/AI cluster only. ROCm 6 support is excellent.
